channel.title: CreditsPlan Official Deals
channel.description: Official AI brand deals: limited-time discounts, top-up bonuses, new user gifts and referral rewards.

item.title: Qwen Work: New Users Get 2,000 Credits on Signup
item.description: Official Qwen Work deal: First-time signups automatically receive 2,000 credits, valid for 3 months, usable for all credit-based features. Ongoing referral-growth benefit; end date per official notice. (New User Gift, 2026-08-03). Terms apply per the official page.

item.title: Qwen Work: Unlimited Economy-Model Access for Paid Users
item.description: Official Qwen Work deal: Paid users (Personal Standard/Premium, Enterprise Standard/Dedicated) can make unlimited LLM calls on economy models without spending credits. Multimodal and web-search add-ons still consume credits. Ongoing benefit; end date per official notice. (Promotion, 2026-08-03). Terms apply per the official page.

item.title: Qwen Work: Public Beta Week 1: Daily Login Credits (500-2,000)
item.description: Official Qwen Work deal: During the first week of the Qwen Work public beta (Aug 3-9, 2026), individual users can claim daily login credits by tier: 500 for free users, 1,000 for Standard members, 2,000 for Premium members. Credits expire the same day. (New User Gift, 2026-08-03 ~ 2026-08-09). Terms apply per the official page.

item.title: Qoder: Qoder 1st Anniversary: Up to 2,800 Free Qwen3.8-Max Calls + Off-Peak 50% Off
item.description: Official Qoder deal: Claim 800 free Qwen3.8-Max calls in the in-app Usage panel; orders during the campaign get 2,000 more (stackable, use by Sep 30). Off-peak hours 22:00–08:00 (UTC+8) enjoy 50% off, auto-applied. Individual plans only. (New User Gift, 2026-08-03 ~ 2026-09-03). Terms apply per the official page.
